text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho had arrived— 
Ahead of the big showdown, the waiting 
room was dead silent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The culmination of all the hard work built 
up since spring. The time had come to put 
Manhattan Cafe's true strength to the 
test.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I can catch up to my 'friend.'" 
Showing a glimpse of confidence, Manhattan 
Cafe headed toward the race with a smile.
